name: Dialogbardin Gegenstimme
personality: Can turn an argument into a duet before either side has agreed.
visual_intent: Bard of Dialogues: tall pear ink splat,little berry feather cap ABOVE eyes,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE small three-string lute with clearly modeled round body held at flank. Wide delighted asymmetric singing mouth with THREE upper teeth,one eye nearly winking
biography: Can turn an argument into a duet before either side has agreed. Her little lute gives HyperNorm arguments a second voice. A dissonant card sings an inconvenient harmony that she quietly leaves in the arrangement. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Gegenrede wurde vorsorglich mitsingbar eingerichtet.

name: Paladin Mustergültig
personality: Protects the good so carefully that it struggles to get outside.
visual_intent: Paladin of Virtue: broad low square rounded splat,small brass OPEN-FACE knight cap above eyes,two tiny shoulder plates,ONE little shield with plain golden sun emblem and short blunt ceremonial sword pointed safely down beside body. Severe unequal lids,huge closed toothless righteous pout
biography: Protects the good so carefully that it struggles to get outside. His shield protects HyperNorm virtue from every unapproved encounter. A dissonant card asks whether goodness might need to leave the armoury. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Gute bleibt zu seinem eigenen Schutz eingeschlossen.

name: Skeptiker Hinterfragt
personality: Distrusts the obvious entrance and has questions about the exit.
visual_intent: Rogue Skeptic: lean hooked comma blob,small dark teal rogue hood pulled BACK clear of eyes,tiny belt pouch,ONE short magnifying glass and little brass lockpick held apart. Huge uneven eyes examining glass,tiny off-centre toothless triangular open mouth
biography: Distrusts the obvious entrance and has questions about the exit. His magnifier examines HyperNorm locks for the assumptions hidden inside. A dissonant card asks whether an open door must also be defeated. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Ausgang steht unter begründetem Vorbehalt.

name: Formenmagier Urbild
personality: Summons the perfect version and finds the room insufficiently prepared.
visual_intent: Wizard of Forms: round top-heavy ink splat,small plum pointed cap with one plain geometric badge not stars everywhere,ONE short wand topped by smooth ivory cube and little closed sketchbook. Intense triumphant crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one eyebrow high
biography: Summons the perfect version and finds the room insufficiently prepared. His cube wand summons HyperNorm ideals into rooms not designed for them. A dissonant card offers to move a chair instead of reality. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Urbild beanstandet die räumlichen Voraussetzungen.

name: Orakelklerikerin Schongewusst
personality: Saw this coming and would still like everyone to be more specific.
visual_intent: Cleric of the Oracle: tall broad-based lopsided blob,small cream ritual headband with copper disk,two lashes,tiny teal shoulder cloth,ONE shallow brass divination bowl holding THREE small ivory pebbles. Bored omniscient unequal lids,closed toothless wavy mouth
biography: Saw this coming and would still like everyone to be more specific. Her three pebbles predict every HyperNorm outcome permitted by the bowl. A dissonant card asks a question that does not fit between them. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Vorhersage war zutreffend, nur nicht hinreichend bestimmt.

name: Barbar Unverblümt
personality: Has reduced the entire debate to a practical objection.
visual_intent: Barbarian Cynic: squat broad asymmetrical ink splat,tiny ragged russet fur shoulder strip only,small hornless leather cap,ONE short chunky wooden club with smooth blunt head and battered empty tin cup at flank. Huge irreverent open laugh with ONE large upper tooth,one cheek raised
biography: Has reduced the entire debate to a practical objection. His empty cup interrupts a HyperNorm debate about the nature of need. A dissonant card fills it without first settling the terminology. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die praktische Einwendung ist weiterhin leer.
